sections.title: Access is not an add-on
body: Most motion players treat access as an add-on: captions missing, keyboard an afterthought, and every player working a little differently.
sections.caption: A player with captions off and the a11y add-on bolted on beside it.

sections.title: Captions from the voice script
body: emaki ships captions from the voice script, so the caption track mirrors the narration, with full keyboard controls for play, seek, scenes and captions.
sections.caption: A captioned frame: CC badge and the voice line as captions.

sections.title: One chrome on every film
body: One consistent chrome means every film works the same way: the same controls, the same scenes, the same captions, everywhere.
sections.caption: One standard toolbar shared by every film.

takeaway: Access is the default, not the add-on.
